system.description:
Starting at 10th level, you’ve trained to battle alongside your allies on the front lines making you an expert combatant. You increase the number of Byakugou Seals you can maintain by 2, increasing your maximum to 6.

Your unarmed attacks gain the Deadly 2 weapon properties, your unarmed and Taijutsu attacks penetrates 4 DR (Damage reduction) and when a creature within 5 feet of you misses you with a melee attack, you gain advantage on your next melee attack, targeting them.

source.custom: Imported full source rules; contextual benefits require adjudication.
